items.title: London Metal Exchange approves Adani's major copper smelter in India as listed brand
items.description: The Adani Copper brand is produced by Kutch Copper, a subsidiary of Adani Enterprises, which is among India's largest copper smelters with an annual production capacity of 500,000 metric tonnes.
